description: Export a sequence with an encoder preset (.epr) (File > Export > Media, or Quick Export): encode it now in Premiere Pro (the call waits; raise PREMIERE_SCRIPT_TIMEOUT_MS for long exports), or queue it in Adobe Media Encoder or Premiere Pro's own queue. The preset sets the format and every Export setting (video, encoding, keyframe distance, audio, captions, effects such as Image Overlay, metadata, VR, HDR, still image sequences); save one from the Export page or Media Encoder. Whole sequence or in to out (set them with set_sequence_times). Without an extension the preset's is added. importIntoProject imports the file afterwards

importBin.description: With importIntoProject: the bin to import into. Default: the project root

name.description: Item name, when only one item has it

path.description: Bin path, "/"-separated, from the project root

importIntoProject.description: With mode immediately: import the exported file into the project (Import into Project). Default false

outputFile.description: Absolute path of the file to write

overwrite.description: Replace outputFile if it exists. Default false

preset.description: Absolute path of an encoder preset (.epr), e.g. one saved from the Export page or Media Encoder

sequence.description: Which sequence. Give its name or guid (from list_sequences); omit for the active sequence

startQueue.description: With queue_to_ame: start Media Encoder's queue (Premiere Pro 26.3 or later). Default false

xmp.description: Write XMP metadata into the file, beside it, both or neither (26.3 or later). Default: Premiere Pro's setting

name: export_sequence
title: Export Sequence
